name: SkillHub brand assets render on landing, onboarding and installed icon
description: Checks that the uploaded SkillHub logo and favicon are wired to the public app shell and install manifest.
steps: Open the signed-out landing page and confirm the SkillHub logo appears without a broken-image indicator
Open the sign-up/onboarding screen and confirm the same logo appears
Sign in and confirm the sidebar logo appears without cropping the full image
Inspect the browser tab icon and web app manifest icon path
expected: The logo loads from /resources/skillhub-logo.jpg in all three UI locations, while the browser and manifest icons resolve to /resources/favicon.jpg.

name: Sign in, complete profile, upload avatar and use the installed app
description: Verifies a new user can create a profile, upload an image, save a portfolio link and navigate the mobile app.
steps: Sign in as a new user and choose Worker
Complete the required profile fields and add a portfolio link
Upload a JPG profile photo and save the profile
Switch dark mode on and use the bottom navigation
expected: The profile photo and portfolio are visible after reload, the dark theme is applied and the mobile navigation remains usable.

name: Customer posts a job, chooses an applicant, chats and both sides can report
covers: live WebSocket chat and message receipts
description: Verifies the normal job flow from posting through selection and conversation, including reports from both sides.
steps: Actor A signs in as a customer and posts a job
Actor B signs in as an available worker and applies
Actor A reviews the applicant profile and selects Actor B
Exchange messages and confirm the recipient sees them live
Actor A and Actor B each submit a report for the job
expected: The selected worker is assigned, the chat is limited to the two participants, message receipt indicators update and both reports are accepted.

name: Worker creates a Team-Up and builds a multi-worker team
description: Verifies a worker can post a collaboration request, accept several applicants and coordinate a team.
steps: Actor A signs in as a worker and creates a Team-Up requiring two additional workers
Actors B and C sign in as workers and apply
Actor A adds both workers to the team
Actor A, B and C open the Team-Up conversation and exchange messages
expected: The Team-Up remains open until the requested number of workers is selected, then becomes in progress and all selected members can access the group chat.

name: Require mutual completion confirmation and allow only one rating per job
description: Verifies a job is not completed until all required participants confirm and each user can rate only once.
steps: Actor A and Actor B open an accepted job
Actor A confirms completion and refreshes Jobs
Actor B confirms completion
Actor A submits a rating and returns to the job history
expected: The job stays in progress after the first confirmation, changes to Completed after the second, and the rating control disappears for Actor A after submission.

name: Saved workers, job cancellation and permission guardrails
description: Verifies saved professionals persist and users cannot perform job actions outside their permissions.
steps: Sign in as a customer and save a worker profile
Open Saved workers and verify the worker appears
Remove the worker from Saved workers
Sign in as a worker and attempt to delete another customer’s job or report a job they did not participate in
expected: Saved workers can be added and removed, and unauthorized deletion or reporting is blocked with a clear message.
